issues.detail: The Hebrew 'לִרְקָמוֹת' (with embroidered things/garments) is an adverbial phrase describing how the virgin is brought to the king ('in embroidered work'), but the Vietnamese renders it as a separate clause 'nàng được mang đến cùng các hoa văn thêu tay' (she is brought with embroidered patterns), which changes the meaning: the Hebrew says she is brought to the king in embroidered garments, not that she is brought along with embroidered patterns as a separate item. This alters the sense of the verse.
